cases.title: Page Six Reporter (Tues-Sat)
cases.text: Job Description : The New York Post delivers news, sports, pop culture and entertainment with unmatched speed, attitude and authority, reaching more than 90 million unique viewers each month. With a 225 year legacy and a fast moving digital first newsroom, the Post operates across print, digital, video, audio, app, television and commerce, and continues to define the city’s most talked about stories. Page Six Digital is the modern evolution of the iconic gossip column, delivering the latest in celebrity news, entertainment, and pop culture with a bold, fast-paced digital edge. As the go-to destination for breaking stories, exclusive scoops, and viral moments, Page Six has grown far beyond its print roots to become a dynamic, multi-platform brand that reaches millions of readers daily across web, social, and video. Page Six is looking for a bold, sharp, and pop culture-obsessed Reporter (Tues-Sat) who lives and breathes celebrity news. This is your chance to join the authority in entertainment gossip and help drive the conversations that everyone will be talking about tomorrow. You’ll pitch and write buzzy, can’t-miss stories daily with speed, accuracy, and unmistakable voice. We want someone who’s always one step ahead—plugged into social media trends, fluent in fan culture, and relentless in uncovering those juicy, under-the-radar scoops that make Page Six sizzle. If you thrive in a fast-paced newsroom, know your way around SEO and analytics, and can spot a viral moment before it breaks, we want to hear from you. Let’s make headlines. Note: The schedule for this role is Tuesday-Saturday 10am-6pm EST. Responsibilities: ● Pitch and write several celebrity- and entertainment-based stories quickly and with clean copy daily ● Proactively seek out and uncover under-the-radar stories that will resonate with the Page Six audience ● Have your finger on the pulse of what fans are talking about on social media and the ability to create content that fits their interests ● Help expand Page Six’s news coverage by monitoring social media and using analytics tools (Google Analytics, Parse.ly, etc.) to achieve success ● Be a self-starter and have the ability to think quickly on their feet and multitask in a fast-paced news environment ● Have an understanding of SEO best practices and analytics and use that knowledge to help guide coverage Qualifications: ● At least two years of major journalism experience ● A deep understanding of and passion for all things celebrity and entertainment ● Exceptional writing and reporting skills ● Ability to write succinct, eye-catching headlines and clean, ready-to-publish content ● Knowledge and understanding of SEO best practices ● Strong editorial judgment and communication skills ● Familiarity with content management systems (Wordpress, in particular), photo editing software & web analytics tools ● Flexibility in covering live pop culture events (i.e. Oscars, Golden Globes, etc.) and working outside traditional business hours when needed Note: The New York Post adheres to an on-site work model. NYC-based candidates will be expected to report into the office 5 days per week. Also open to LA-based candidates. cases.text: Job Description : The New York Post delivers the best in news, sports, entertainment and pop culture with wit, irreverence, and authority. Our goal is to drive the news rather than just following what everyone else is doing — and to expose the unexpected sides of front-page hot topics. To excel in this role, you need a proven track record of producing in-depth, multi-source stories that have moved the cultural needle. We want someone bursting with inspired ideas. cases.title: Prepress Technician
cases.text: Job Description : The New York Post delivers the best in news, sports, entertainment and pop culture with wit, irreverence, and authority. Over the past 225+ years, The Post has evolved into a multi-platform media company spanning print, digital, video, audio, app, television and commerce. We are looking for two Prepress Technicians to join our Prepress Operations team. In this role, you’ll play a critical part in our daily print production process, ensuring the accurate, high-quality, and timely preparation and production of our pages. Responsibilities: Output Management Manage the transmission of pages to all print sites, troubleshoot transmission systems, and distribute production schedules. Maintain communication with print sites regarding production updates and page adjustments. Customer Service Monitor pages for technical errors and quality issues, and recommend actions to ensure quality and deadline adherence. Track production times and maintain detailed reports. Foster strong, collaborative relationships with editorial staff and photo editors to ensure high-quality product delivery and effective communication. Review color page proofs and perform necessary adjustments for optimal reproduction. Pagination Build and maintain page plans within production systems according to editorial specifications. Assist editorial users of the Methode pagination system with programming, troubleshooting, and training. Imaging Produce high-quality black-and-white and color image separations. Perform in-depth color correction, adjust contrast and brightness for newsprint, and optimize detail while preserving pixel integrity. Manage time effectively to meet deadlines, prioritizing complex or high-scrutiny imagery as needed. Professional Development Stay current with departmental workflows, procedures, and emerging technologies. Proactively suggest improvements to existing processes to enhance production efficiency. Requirements: 1+ years of experience in prepress production, print operations, or a related technical print environment. Working knowledge of page transmission systems and troubleshooting production/output issues. Strong attention to detail with the ability to monitor pages for technical and quality errors under deadline pressure. Experience with pagination systems (Methode experience preferred), including programming, troubleshooting, and user support/training. Proficiency in image correction and color separation for print, including adjusting contrast, brightness, and color for newsprint reproduction. Excellent communication and relationship-building skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with editorial staff and photo editors. Strong time-management skills, with the ability to prioritize complex or high-scrutiny work under tight deadlines. A proactive approach to process improvement and staying current with emerging prepress technologies. Note: The New York Post adheres to an on-site work model. This role will be expected to report into the office 5 days per week. cases.title: Breaking News Politics Reporter (DC-Based)
cases.text: Job Description : The New York Post provides readers with the best in News, Sports, Pop Culture, and Entertainment – with signature wit, irreverence, and authority, averaging 90 million unique monthly viewers. Over the past 225 years, The Post has evolved into a multi-platform media company spanning print, digital, video, audio, app, television, and commerce. Politics is core to who we are — and nobody covers it like The Post. We break big stories, stir the pot, and shine a light on what’s really going on in the nation’s capital. From policy drama and power grabs to scandals and backstabbing, we’re looking for someone who gets the whole DC circus and can help lead the way in breaking news. The New York Post is seeking an enterprising DC-based Breaking News Politics Reporter (Sunday - Thursday) to join our growing DC team and cover the fast-moving world of Washington politics. This reporter will write about the big political stories of the day, spot trending news, and bring readers sharp, authoritative coverage of how decisions in the capital shape the nation. Responsibilities: Report and write breaking news and enterprise stories on DC politics and government actions. Spot news from political interviews, speeches and social media postings Land interviews with power brokers in DC politics Cover legislative battles, policy shifts, elections, and key political figures. Break exclusive stories and find fresh angles on widely covered issues. Build and maintain a strong network of sources, from lawmakers and lobbyists to administration and campaign officials. Stay on top of political developments in real time and file timely, accurate copy. Use public records, FOIA requests, and social media to surface and verify stories. Work closely with editors and colleagues to produce fast, engaging coverage across digital and social platforms. Requirements: Minimum three years of newsroom reporting experience, with a focus on DC or political coverage. Experience writing about the White House and Congress and building sources within the Trump administration Fast, accurate and efficient, high-impact reporting Strong editorial judgment and writing skills under tight deadlines. Available to work Sunday to Thursday Flexibility to work evenings and irregular hours as news demands . Note: This role will be expected to report into the Washington, DC Bureau. cases.text: Job Description : The New York Post provides readers with the best in News, Sports, Pop Culture and Entertainment – with signature wit, irreverence and authority averaging 90 million unique viewers a month.
